name: Win Effects
displayDescription:
Get 4 unique win effects that show upon winning. You can also choose to randomly select a win effect each round.

Your win effect will show next to tiles that you revealed.

name: Supporter
displayDescription: Support the game, receive a flag and a custom chat tag.

name: Firework Flag [XMAS LIMITED]
displayDescription:
A firework flag that spawns in different colors over time. Has a rare chance to fly up in the sky.

Can only be purchased during Christmas Event.

name: Spruce Flag [XMAS LIMITED]
displayDescription:
A spruce tree flag that sometimes has a layer of snow or coloured lights on it.

Can only be purchased during Christmas Event.
